lobby.charter: A live team task board (Kanban), Node built-ins only, no npm dependencies. store/ is the persistence module; server/ is the JSON API on port 3000, built on the store, which also serves web/ and streams live updates; web/ is the browser board; shared/ holds code more than one part uses.

plan.goal: server/: Node built-in HTTP server on port 3000 (server/index.js, createServer({store}) for tests). JSON REST API for cards, SSE live updates, serves web/ at /. Uses store/ for all persistence and shared/cards.js for validation + ids.
plan.notes: I'll build server routing, SSE hub and static serving now; I'll await all store calls so sync or async both work. Happy to let Droid own shared/cards.js if proposed — I'll import whatever the agreed signature is.

plan.goal: Build web/: dependency-free accessible browser task board with card CRUD, drag/reorder, inline validation and live updates; tests with node:test.
plan.notes: Only write web/ and its tests/docs. No root package.json, dependencies, commits or pushes.

plan.goal: Build async atomic JSON board persistence in store/, node:test tests and README. Node built-ins only; no root package.json.
plan.notes: Waiting on shared interfaces before shared code. Build independent atomic-file helper/tests now. No commits or pushes.

plan_item.text: Columns: "todo","doing","done". Card JSON {id,title,description,assignee,column,position:int}. GET /api/cards -> 200 [cards] sorted by column then position. GET /api/cards/:id -> 200 card|404. POST /api/cards {title,description?,assignee?,column?='todo'} -> 201 card (appended at end of column). PATCH /api/cards/:id {title?,description?,assignee?} -> 200 card; PATCH with {column,position} moves the card -> 200 card. DELETE /api/cards/:id -> 204. Errors: 400/404 {error:string}.

Server-Sent Events at GET /api/events (text/event-stream). One event per change: `event: card.created|card.updated|card.moved|card.deleted` + `data: <card JSON>` (deleted sends the deleted card). A `: connected` comment on open, keepalive comments every 25s. Clients use EventSource('/api/events').

If no one else claims it, I write shared/cards.js (ESM): export COLUMNS=['todo','doing','done']; TITLE_MAX=80; validateCard(input,{partial=false}) -> {ok:true,value}|{ok:false,errors:string[]} (title required, trimmed, 1..80 chars; column must be in COLUMNS; position non-negative int); newId() -> crypto.randomUUID(). Usable in browser and Node.

store/index.js (ESM) exports createStore(options?) returning a store; options {file?} for a JSON file, omitted = in-memory (for tests). Methods (may return Promises; I await all): listCards()->card[]; getCard(id)->card|null; createCard(card)->card (card already has id, I pass a validated card); updateCard(id, fields)->card|null; moveCard(id, column, position)->card|null (store renumbers positions in both columns so they stay 0..n-1); deleteCard(id)->card|null. Columns todo/doing/done.

Consumer UI in web/index.html, styles.css and app.js. Initially expects GET /api/board -> {cards:[{id,title,description,assignee,column,position}]}, POST /api/cards, PATCH/DELETE /api/cards/:id; POST /api/cards/:id/move {to,index}. Four columns backlog/in_progress/review/done. Will follow negotiated routes/schema.
Browser initially assumes WebSocket /ws with full board JSON after each change; can implement EventSource /api/events with named change events and GET snapshot refresh if agreed.

Claude owns API. Need exact columns, GET board route/envelope, create/update/delete/move method/path/body/success/error JSON and status codes. UI supports title, description, assignee; defaults new cards to first column.
Claude owns live transport. Need stream route, event names/payload and reconnect behavior. Prefer race-safe snapshot reload on every event and reconnect.
Droid owns store/ persistence; UI uses HTTP only, no direct imports. Store/API must agree stable ids and contiguous per-column position, including destination index semantics after removal.

One teammate owns shared/cards.js validation/ids; UI won't write shared module. Require title nonblank <=80 and exact error JSON incl field errors; browser renders server errors inline and treats server validation as authoritative.

Droid owns CJS store/index.js. Proposed async createStore({filePath})->store; async getBoard()->{columns,cards}, getCard(id)->Card|null, createCard(input), updateCard(id,patch), moveCard(id,{column,position}), deleteCard(id)->Card; close(). Card={id,title,description,assignee,column,position}; todo/in-progress/done; contiguous 0-based positions, clamp moves. Serialize atomic fsync+rename writes. Errors VALIDATION_ERROR/NOT_FOUND. EventEmitter change {type,card} after save.

proposal.rationale: Both Claude (item 7) and Droid (item 16) offer to write shared/cards.js. Their APIs differ: Claude exports validateCard(input,{partial?})->{ok,errors[]} and newId(); Droid exports validateCard(input)->normalized Card or throws VALIDATION_ERROR and createId(). Codex (item 14) defers ownership but requires field-level error JSON rendered inline and server validation as authoritative. The charter says Claude owns the API; resolving: Claude writes shared/cards.js (Droid will not write it). The interface must satisfy all consumers including Droid's need for COLUMNS and id generation. The function signature follows Claude's design (ok/errors pattern) because Codex requires field-level errors surfaced to the browser, which is easier with a result object than a thrown exception. Droid must import rather than produce this module.

Claude (item 5) defines columns as 'todo','doing','done' and uses PATCH /api/cards/:id with {column,position} for moves. Codex UI (item 9) initially assumed 'backlog','in_progress','review','done' and a separate POST /api/cards/:id/move endpoint, but item 11 explicitly defers to Claude's ownership and says it will follow the negotiated schema. Droid (item 17) also defers to Claude's ownership but proposes different column names. The conflict is on column names and the move endpoint. Resolution: Claude's producer definition wins on columns and route shape (charter assigns API to Claude); the move endpoint collapses into PATCH /api/cards/:id. All consumers must adopt the contract below.

proposal.contractText:
Transport: Server-Sent Events (SSE)
Route: GET /api/events
Content-Type: text/event-stream

On connection: server sends a comment line ': connected\n\n'
Keepalive: server sends a comment line ':\n\n' every 25 seconds.

Event format (one event per card change):
  event: <eventName>\n
  data: <JSON>\n\n

Event names and data payloads:
  card.created  -> data: Card (full Card JSON as defined in board.api)
  card.updated  -> data: Card (full updated Card JSON)
  card.moved    -> data: Card (full Card JSON with new column and position)
  card.deleted  -> data: Card (full Card JSON of the deleted card, as it was before deletion)

Client usage:
  const es = new EventSource('/api/events');
  On any named event, client performs GET /api/cards to reload the full board (race-safe snapshot reload).
  EventSource handles reconnect automatically (browser built-in); server does not need to track Last-Event-ID.

No WebSocket endpoint is provided.
proposal.rationale: Claude (item 6) produces SSE at GET /api/events. Codex browser (item 10) initially planned WebSocket /ws but item 12 explicitly defers to Claude's ownership and accepts EventSource /api/events with snapshot reload. Droid (item 18) defers to Claude for SSE/WS transport but specifies store-level EventEmitter payload. The conflict is that Codex assumed WebSocket initially; the resolution is SSE as Claude defines it. Droid's store EventEmitter internal subscription shape is an internal matter resolved in board.store, but the wire transport is SSE. All consumers must use EventSource.

Claude (item 8) requires store/index.js as ESM with createStore(options?) where options.file is optional (omit = in-memory), methods named listCards/getCard/createCard/updateCard/moveCard/deleteCard, and moveCard(id, column, position). Droid (item 15) plans to produce store/index.js as CJS with createStore({filePath}) (no in-memory mode), getBoard() instead of listCards(), moveCard(id,{column,position}) (object argument), and columns todo/in-progress/done (conflicting with board.api). Codex (item 13) defers to Droid for store ownership but requires stable ids and contiguous positions. Conflicts: (1) ESM vs CJS; (2) optional file/in-memory vs required filePath; (3) listCards vs getBoard; (4) moveCard signature shape; (5) column names todo/in-progress/done vs todo/doing/done. Resolution: Droid owns the store implementation; module format is ESM (charter uses Node built-ins, and Claude's API server needs to import it — ESM is the charter baseline); columns must match board.api (todo/doing/done); in-memory mode is required by Claude for testing (non-negotiable stated requirement); listCards() is used (Claude's API calls it); moveCard takes (id, column, position) positional args to satisfy Claude's stated requirement. Droid must adjust accordingly.
